text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world at incredible speed, but it also raises serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: if an AI system learns from data that contains human prejudice, it can make unfair decisions, for example in hiring or lending. Fairness requires that we carefully check these systems to ensure they treat everyone equally. Another key issue is privacy. Many AI tools collect personal information, so designers must protect users' data and be clear about how it is used. This connects to transparency—people deserve to understand why an AI made a particular choice. For these reasons, responsible AI development is essential. This means involving diverse teams, testing for unintended effects, and making sure that as AI grows more powerful, it serves society ethically and openly.
